methods.raster: PNG composited on white, resampled to 128×128 with Lanczos; RGB histogram 8 bins/channel; Hellinger distance.
methods.palette: Median-cut 6-color quantization, reported weighted RGB means; not artist-chosen paint-color counts.
methods.background: Remove RGB pixels within Euclidean distance 24 of the modal border-bin median when at least 70% of border samples agree. Experimental heuristic, not semantic segmentation.
methods.strokePercentile: Midrank within imported collection; includes all recorded lines.
methods.trajectory: Sum of point-to-point polyline distances excluding explicitly marked background/ref passes, divided by smaller logical canvas dimension; not smoothed SVG length or creation time.
methods.edge: Share of adjacent 128px luminance samples differing by more than 20; a display-scale texture proxy, not artistic quality.

limitations: Palette similarities are candidate links requiring visual/editorial review.
Background removal may suppress meaningful interior colors or frames.
No per-point timestamps: duration, speed and effort cannot be recovered.
Sequence describes owned works, not a complete artist catalogue.
Metadata creation dates are recorded ink creation, not necessarily when the artist finished painting.
